```{r}
# Librerías necesarias
library(ordinalNet)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)
library(caret)

# 1. Cargar datos
data <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("datos_PCA.xlsx")

# 2. Variable respuesta como factor ordenado
niveles_ordenados <- c("RC", "RP", "EE", "PE")
y <- factor(data$Mejor_resp, levels = niveles_ordenados, ordered = TRUE)

# 3. Crear matriz X
data_predictoras <- data[, !(colnames(data) %in% c("Mejor_resp", "X1ª_eval"))]

# Convertir caracteres a factor
data_predictoras[] <- lapply(data_predictoras, function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) as.factor(x) else x
})

# One-hot encoding (sin intercepto)
X <- model.matrix(~ . -1, data = data_predictoras)

# 4. Validación Leave-One-Out manual
set.seed(123)
pred_loo <- vector("character", length = nrow(X))

for (i in 1:nrow(X)) {
  X_train <- X[-i, , drop = FALSE]
  y_train <- y[-i]
  X_test  <- X[i, , drop = FALSE]

  modelo_i <- ordinalNet(
    x = X_train,
    y = y_train,
    family = "cumulative",
    link = "logit",
    parallelTerms = TRUE,
    nonparallelTerms = FALSE,
    alpha = 1
  )

  pred <- predict(modelo_i, newx = X_test, type = "class")
  pred_loo[i] <- ifelse(is.null(pred), NA, as.character(pred))
}

# 5. Evaluación
pred_loo_factor <- factor(pred_loo, levels = 1:4, labels = niveles_ordenados, ordered = TRUE)
y <- factor(y, levels = niveles_ordenados, ordered = TRUE)

# 6. Matriz de confusión
confusionMatrix(pred_loo_factor, y)
```

# 10-100

```{r}
set.seed(123)  # Reproducibilidad

library(ordinalNet)
library(caret)

resultados <- data.frame(Iteracion = integer(), Accuracy = numeric(), Variables = character())

for (iter in 1:100) {
  # 1. Selección aleatoria de 15 variables
  vars_aleatorias <- sample(colnames(X), size = 10)
  X_reducido <- X[, vars_aleatorias, drop = FALSE]

  # 2. Inicializar predicciones LOO
  pred_loo <- vector("character", length = nrow(X_reducido))

  for (i in 1:nrow(X_reducido)) {
    X_train <- X_reducido[-i, , drop = FALSE]
    y_train <- y[-i]
    X_test  <- X_reducido[i, , drop = FALSE]

    modelo_i <- ordinalNet(
      x = X_train,
      y = y_train,
      family = "cumulative",
      link = "logit",
      parallelTerms = TRUE,
      nonparallelTerms = FALSE,
      alpha = 1
    )

    pred <- predict(modelo_i, newx = X_test, type = "class")
    pred_loo[i] <- if (is.null(pred)) NA else as.character(pred)
  }

  # 3. Evaluación
  niveles_ordenados <- levels(y)
  pred_loo_factor <- factor(pred_loo, levels = 1:4, labels = niveles_ordenados, ordered = TRUE)

  cm <- confusionMatrix(pred_loo_factor, y)

  # 4. Guardar resultados
  acc <- cm$overall["Accuracy"]
  resultados <- rbind(resultados, data.frame(
    Iteracion = iter,
    Accuracy = as.numeric(acc),
    Variables = paste(vars_aleatorias, collapse = ", ")
  ))
  
  cat("Iteración", iter, "- Accuracy:", round(acc, 3), "\n")
}

# Ver top 5 combinaciones más prometedoras
resultados_top <- resultados[order(-resultados$Accuracy), ]
print(head(resultados_top, 5))
```

# 0.647

```{r}
# Librerías
library(ordinalNet)
library(openxlsx)
library(caret)

# Leer los datos
data <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("datos_PCA.xlsx")

# Variable respuesta
y <- factor(data$Mejor_resp, levels = c("RC", "RP", "EE", "PE"), ordered = TRUE)

# Matriz de predictores
data_predictoras <- data[, !(colnames(data) %in% c("Mejor_resp", "X1ª_eval"))]
data_predictoras[] <- lapply(data_predictoras, function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) as.factor(x) else x
})
X <- model.matrix(~ . -1, data = data_predictoras)

# Variables seleccionadas (de la iteración 8)
mejores_vars <- c(
  "Leukocytes_slope", "Smoking_exposure", "Platelets_cv", 
  "SII_diff_2C_1eval", "Platelets_media", "Lymphocytes_cv", 
  "PCR", "PLR_slope", "SII_diff_1C_2C", "Platelets_diff_2C_1eval"
)

X_mejores <- X[, mejores_vars, drop = FALSE]

# LOO
pred_loo <- vector("character", length = nrow(X_mejores))
for (i in 1:nrow(X_mejores)) {
  X_train <- X_mejores[-i, , drop = FALSE]
  y_train <- y[-i]
  X_test  <- X_mejores[i, , drop = FALSE]

  modelo_i <- ordinalNet(
    x = X_train,
    y = y_train,
    family = "cumulative",
    link = "logit",
    parallelTerms = TRUE,
    nonparallelTerms = FALSE,
    alpha = 1
  )

  pred <- predict(modelo_i, newx = X_test, type = "class")
  pred_loo[i] <- if (is.null(pred)) NA else as.character(pred)
}

# Evaluación
niveles_ordenados <- levels(y)
pred_loo_factor <- factor(pred_loo, levels = 1:4, labels = niveles_ordenados, ordered = TRUE)
confusionMatrix(pred_loo_factor, y)
```
